title: Elodie and the Clock
author: Emrys Sandoval
blurb: Emrys Sandoval, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
